messages:
maria.docs: Quick FYI — I opened a small PR to add a micro migration guide and an SDK snippet for Optimize toolkit changes around batching/cache/quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5423
sam.platform: Thanks! Can you call out the compatibility table? people keep asking which quant profiles are compatible with onnx/qkv reorder.
ajay.ml: Also make sure we add the recommended default for production (prefetch + kv-cache + dynamic batching). A tiny example is enough.
maria.docs: Good call. I added a compatibility matrix stub and a short snippet. Can folks sanity-check the snippet?
kelly-pm: I can eyeball for product phrasing. Assign reviewers and set the milestone?
maria.docs: Assigned sam.platform and ajay.ml. Milestone: docs/q2-optimize.
lee-sdk: Quick glance: the Python snippet's batching config uses `max_batch_size=32` which is risky for low-latency tiers — suggest 8 as default and add note.
ajay.ml: Agreed. Also quant profile example: current snippet shows a 4-bit profile we shouldn't recommend broadly. We should include both recommended (q4_0-fp16-fallback) and an aggressive (q4_1) with caution.
maria.docs: Updated snippet — lowered batch default to 8 and included two quant profiles. Pasted snippet below for reviewers:```json
{
  "batching": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_batch_size": 8,
    "queue_timeout_ms": 12
  },
  "caching": {
    "kv_cache": true,
    "prefix_cache": { "enabled": true, "ttl_seconds": 300 }
  },
  "quant_profile": "q4_0-fp16-fallback",
  "fallback_profiles": ["q4_1"]
}
```sam.platform: nice. Please also add a short note that `queue_timeout_ms` trades latency vs cost and link to the batching playbook.
maria.docs: added link to internal guide: https://redwood-internal/docs/optimize/batching-playbook (placeholder)
ci-bot: Checks started for PR #5423 — running linkcheck and snippet-lint
ci-bot: linkcheck: passed
ci-bot: snippet-lint: failed — flagged inline code style in the Python example (line 9)
lee-sdk: I can fix the Python string formatting in a follow-up commit. Want me to push to the PR branch?
maria.docs: please do, thanks. If you can also add a one-liner example showing `client.generate(stream=True)` for streaming tokens that would be helpful.
lee-sdk: Will push a small commit in ~30m.
kelly-pm: Product note — add a short callout about enterprise customers that rely on pinned model variants; say rollback guidance in case quant causes regressions.
ajay.ml: I'll write the rollback paragraph. Suggest: keep canary % small, run evals on canonical prompt suite, revert to q4_0-fp16-fallback if regression > 1.5% on quality metric.
maria.docs: Perfect. I'll merge once CI green and lee-sdk's snippet fix is in. Can we aim to merge by EOD?
sam.platform: schedule LGTM for today after lee's fix.
lee-sdk: pushed commit fixing snippet formatting and added streaming example. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5423/commits/8f3a2b
ci-bot: snippet-lint: passed
ci-bot: all checks passed — PR ready for review
maria.docs: merging. Thanks everyone! :tada: If any follow-ups, open small PRs and ping #docs.
